# Gender Identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GenderIdentity`](gmeow-GenderIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GenderIdentity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A person's SELF-ASSERTED gender identity — what they are — as a reified facet pointing (via [`gmeow:genderValue`](../properties/gmeow-genderValue.md)) to an open [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) value. Independent of pronouns/honorifics (address), of gender expression, and of sex-assigned-at-birth; nothing infers any of these from another. Multiple co-equal [`GenderIdentity`](gmeow-GenderIdentity.md) facets express bigender/genderfluid/transition without privileging any.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GenderIdentity`](gmeow-GenderIdentity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Self Asserted Facets

- **Source:** [`slices/core/gender/examples/self-asserted-facets.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/gender/examples/self-asserted-facets.ttl)

```turtle
# --- The self-asserted identity: subject is its own vantage; displayed.
ex:selfId a gmeow:GenderIdentity ;
    gmeow:facetSubject  ex:robin ;
    gmeow:facetVantage  ex:robin ;
    gmeow:genderValue   gmeow:genderNonBinary ;
    gmeow:selfAsserted  true ;
    gmeow:displayable   true .

# --- An external registry's conflicting record: its vantage is the REGISTRY,
#     not Robin — kept for provenance but SUPPRESSED (P10) and never self-
#     asserted, because self-assertion outranks an imported datum.
ex:registryId a gmeow:GenderIdentity ;
    gmeow:facetSubject ex:robin ;
    gmeow:facetVantage ex:registry ;
    gmeow:genderValue  gmeow:genderWoman ;
    gmeow:selfAsserted false ;
    gmeow:displayable  false .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record what a person identifies as, as a self-asserted facet pointing at an open [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) value; mint one facet per co-equal identity so bigender, genderfluid, or a transition are all expressible without privileging any.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for how a person presents ([`gmeow:GenderExpression`](gmeow-GenderExpression.md)), for how they are addressed (pronouns/honorifics in names), and for the recorded sex datum ([`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](../properties/gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md)); never infer one of these from another.

### How to use

- Attach via [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md), set [`gmeow:genderValue`](../properties/gmeow-genderValue.md) to a seeded or freshly minted [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) individual, and carry [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) when the identity is fuzzy or fluid; supersede a label with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deletion.

### Examples

- ex:gi a [`gmeow:GenderIdentity`](gmeow-GenderIdentity.md); [`gmeow:genderValue`](../properties/gmeow-genderValue.md) [`gmeow:genderNonBinary`](../individuals/gmeow-genderNonBinary.md); [`gmeow:selfAsserted`](../properties/gmeow-selfAsserted.md) true; [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) [`gmeow:determinacyFuzzy`](../individuals/gmeow-determinacyFuzzy.md).
